finding: Current execution recorder is event/milestone sampled, not an exhaustive per-monitor-run lifecycle ledger. Removing read truncation alone would not certify NO_BUY.
evidence: Recorder writes OPEN_BASELINE, FIRST_10M_COMPLETE, FIRST_15M_COMPLETE, FIRST_30M_COMPLETE, and FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED only while monitor results exist.
FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED is emitted when the notification batch is nonempty; same-symbol matching is required to interpret a row as that symbol's signal.
The protected read path is additionally newest-first LIMIT 500 and exposes newest 80, so exact-date absence is doubly unidentifiable.
INSERT OR IGNORE idempotency proves duplicate suppression, not expected monitor-run completeness.
observationalEquivalenceForMissingBuy: Formal monitor did not run or failed for part/all of the relevant session.
Formal monitor ran but the selected plan/symbol was absent from one or more runs.
Formal monitor ran and plan was observed but no BUY condition occurred.
A BUY/signal row existed but is outside the bounded read surface.
Batch-level FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED exists but not for this symbol.
requiredProspectiveReceipt: expected monitor schedule/runs for that deployed version
actual monitor run ids with startedAt/completedAt/status
per-run plan membership and quote/15m freshness quality
per-run final decision/action state or a lossless lifecycle transition receipt
first/last observed timestamps and explicit session-complete flag
safeClassification: NO_BUY_COMPLETE: only when expected-vs-actual monitor coverage and plan membership are complete and no BUY signal/action exists.
ACTUAL_FILL_UNKNOWN: unless trusted broker/order lifecycle exists.
consequence: Historical selectedPlans=4/buyTriggeredPlans=1 does not establish a 25% plan-level BUY rate for a named date/cohort and cannot quantify 75% policy-caused idle capital.
optimizationBridge: No BUY-rule relaxation candidate can use NO_BUY frequency until lifecycle completeness is certified. Continue cause-specific falsification only on positive/complete evidence.
